public.text: Sex at birth is mandatory for every national identity record, but its necessity depends on the identity-matching and care use case. It is sensitive, may be unknown or contested, and is distinct from administrative sex and clinical attributes.
public.suggestedRevision: Make it conditional where justified by defined purposes. Separate sex-related concepts clearly, permit unknown or undisclosed values, restrict access, and apply inclusive governance.
